truthBoundary: Code/UI/replay tests do not establish live operational or financial truth.

priorities.P2: product differentiation and scale after underlying authorities

items.name: Durable Authority / Render database admission
items.acceptance: Bind a verified existing PostgreSQL resource internally; exact deployed SHA /ready=200, dataMode=postgres, Golden Paths and capital verifier PASS; restore/rollback evidence.

items.name: Historical SQL 026/027 and schema parity
items.acceptance: Independently attest historical sources or independently prove equivalent full catalog/roles/provenance; no false hash/history entry; PG17 replay and restore.

items.name: Future-object ACL and privileged service boundary
items.acceptance: Independently review creator default ACLs (tables, sequences, functions, PUBLIC), service-role access, forward-only hardening, two-creator canaries and live after-check.

items.name: Verified Auth/JWT/session/organisation authorisation
items.acceptance: Actual signed-token verification, freshness/session revocation, 2+ organisations negative HTTP tests, finance-actor step-up, deny role leakage.

items.name: Independent reviews and integration release controls
items.acceptance: Reviewer approval, integrated exact-head suite, phone/tablet/desktop visual QA, safe deployment/rollback and zero cross-role metadata leakage.

items.name: Golden Paths: attendee → QR → check-in → persistence
items.acceptance: Real authenticated role flows on PostgreSQL: registration/accreditation/pass issuance/duplicate QR/restart/revocation; independent receipts.

items.name: Durable outbox, job retries and pg-boss
items.acceptance: Atomic domain/outbox; worker retry/poison queue/crash-after-commit; independent multi-consumer receipts and recoverable jobs.

items.name: Consent and Brand CRM/CDP real delivery
items.acceptance: Authenticated brand/customer scopes, consent and opt-out, frequency caps, delivery and revenue attribution negative tests.

items.name: MFW agenda/show/collection/registration UX
items.acceptance: Full user path from verified programme to agenda and show access, conflicts/reminders, offline/online transparency, real-device UX.

items.name: BFS delegates, session and bilateral meetings
items.acceptance: Speaker/organisation/session correctness, availability, bilateral acceptance, cancellation/waitlist, cross-tenant negative tests.

items.name: LIVE ingest, HLS playback and Replay availability
items.acceptance: Signed stream-provider adapter, player error/fallback/captions, rights, real replay artefacts and end-to-end incident tests.

items.name: Signed Wallet passes and rotating QR separation
items.acceptance: Certificate-backed Wallet projection, per-device revocation, copied/stale payload denied at venue; no persistent reusable gate secret.

items.name: Programme Production and CFP desk
items.acceptance: Proposal → review → speaker clearance → approved immutable programme snapshot with revision/rollback and publication evidence.

items.name: Sponsor inventory, acceptance and renewal
items.acceptance: Signed inventory/placement/version; verified delivery SLA → sponsor approval and evidence; attribution not relabelled incremental.

items.name: Made in Moscow Verified roster and Buyer Bridge
items.acceptance: Independent residence verification, canonical IDs, expired badge revocation, partner Hub and buyer flow with proof/permissions.

items.name: Brand365 Loyalty wallet and post-event retention
items.acceptance: 30/60/90-day real persistence, opt-in, redemption once, multi-device restart, CRM retention and fraud negative tests.

items.name: Buyer/Brand Deal Room and commercial handoff
items.acceptance: Bilateral buyer/brand grants, proposal/version/document confidentiality, structured handoff, external proof distinct from lead/revenue.

items.name: Pilot-to-Revenue server evidence and reconciliation
items.acceptance: Actual trusted invoice/finance/bank sources, accepted evidence, partial receipts, credits/refunds, tenant-secure immutable store, double-charge recovery.

items.name: Investor Economics Studio and Evidence Control Tower
items.acceptance: Scenario inputs remain modelled; validated investor dossiers compare accepted vs missing evidence, actual money only from authoritative finance.

items.name: Editorial publishing and media rights/embargo
items.acceptance: Media licensing provenance, approval/retraction/embargo and valid usage across MFW, BFS and partners.

items.name: Operational observability, incidents and support
items.acceptance: Trace IDs, masked failure logs, SLO/latency, alert ownership, incident replay and documented disaster recovery.

items.name: Notifications and calendar availability adapter
items.acceptance: Scheduled reminders/schedule changes with idempotency, consent, timezone-safe meetings, opt-out, tested provider outage.

items.name: Privileged step-up authentication and key lifecycle
items.acceptance: Passkeys or reviewed MFA for organisers/finance, issuer rotation, status/revocation distribution and adversarial proof.

items.name: Physical venue operations capacity/check-in safety
items.acceptance: Capacity/queue/floor state and incident authority, manual override audit, stale QR, staff offline sync and recovery.

items.name: Unified discovery search and agenda ICS
items.acceptance: Rebuildable tenant-safe index, ranking/freshness QA, revocation, event conflicts and verified calendar export.

items.name: Accessible venue map and temporary closures
items.acceptance: Mapped entrances/zones, step-free paths and live closure authority with route rerouting; phone QA.

items.name: Personalised recommendations/matchmaking fairness
items.acceptance: Explainable reason codes, bilateral acceptance, no private inference, diversity and offline baseline.

items.name: Moderated LIVE Q&A, polls and replay bridge
items.acceptance: Moderated queue, spam/rate and privacy policy, approved replay anchoring and accessibility.

items.name: Searchable multilingual replay and captions
items.acceptance: Permissioned caption assets, translations/source accuracy and rights, moderation, provenance and retention.

items.name: Partner API, metering and developer portal
items.acceptance: Scoped API contracts, usage entitlements, signed webhooks, idempotent metering and developer key rotation.

items.name: Portable Fashion Network Trust Passport
items.acceptance: Issuer credential and revocation, scoped verification receipts, no universal reputation ranking, privacy-safe sharing.

items.name: Privacy-safe industry intelligence benchmarks
items.acceptance: Consented minimum cohort size, suppression, anti-reidentification, analytical provenance, monetisation gated by evidence.

items.name: Persistent fashion network & institutional interoperability
items.acceptance: Interchange profile, verified organisation roles, scoped institutional publishing and repeat-provenance graph.

items.name: Accessibility and visual E2E across three experiences
items.acceptance: Real iOS Safari/Android, keyboard/VoiceOver, focus states, contrast/touch targets and high-fidelity screenshot QA.

items.name: Controlled experimentation and growth attribution
items.acceptance: Deterministic holdouts, source linking, no sample contamination, stat limits, unbiased lift and ROI truth classes.
